definitions.explanation: A category of people sharing certain physical characteristics or ancestry.

examples.japanese: {人種|じんしゅ}⟦{差別|さべつ}→差別：01633_sabetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な{人種|じんしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: People of various races live in America.

examples.japanese: {人種|じんしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{平等|びょうどう}→平等：03590_byoudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{扱|あつか}われる→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧⟦べき→べき：10016_beki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: People should be treated equally regardless of race.

notes:
{人種|じんしゅ} refers to racial or ethnic categories.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人種|じんしゅ}⟦{差別|さべつ}→差別：01633_sabetsu⟧ (racial discrimination)
- {人種|じんしゅ}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (racial issues)
- {人種|じんしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧ (racial barrier)
- ⟦{混血|こんけつ}→混血：18670_konketsu⟧{人種|じんしゅ} (mixed race)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {人種|じんしゅ}: race (physical/biological classification)
- ⟦{民族|みんぞく}→民族：13229_minzoku⟧: ethnic group, people (cultural identity)
- ⟦{国籍|こくせき}→国籍：02755_kokuseki⟧: nationality (legal citizenship)
